title: Creator Project Management
objective: Add a private human project-management surface that composes the existing authenticated owner-authorized project and publication HTTP boundaries without moving ownership, persistence, concurrency, publication, or rights authority into browser code.
projectManagement: Explicitly return one creator-owned project to private.
concurrency: Browser UI does not render persistence revision.
Browser UI does not submit expectedRevision.
Existing project operation service performs current snapshot and conditional persistence checks.
privacy: Project id is route-only and may appear in href/API routing but not as visible project metadata.
Lifecycle timestamps are not rendered by this slice.
publication: Only private and public presentation states are available.
Publication is an explicit owner-authorized operation.
Public presentation does not grant copyright, master, composition, publishing, distribution, label, management, royalty, licensing, revenue, collaborator, legal, CRM, account, or identity rights.
sitemap: The complete /sesh/studio/ namespace is excluded from the public sitemap.
